I fully admit to the fact that FPH saved my life. Maybe in a different way than people think, but it definitely did.

I was never obese, but I had a horrible relationship with food. I have BPD (Borderline Personality Disorder) and one of the things that is common to pair with that is disordered eating and BOY did I fit that standard. I would gain and lose 50lbs within a few months like nothing, it was awful. I'd binge on shit I didn't even really enjoy and starve myself for 2-3 days afterwards (probably what a lot of these hams consider "anorexia" though that does not fit the diagnostic criteria at all). I had finally lost enough weight to get into the healthy weight range, but I hadn't really gotten to the root of the problem itself, and we all know that if you don't, you'll balloon yourself up to where you were in no time.

That's when FPH came in. It wasn't so much the posts, though I enjoyed them and still do, it was the commenters that really got me on track. I read stories about people from all walks of life, who had all sorts of set backs and problems to deal with, who still got their shit together in the end and fucking did what they wanted/needed to do. And that helped me deal with so many problems related to BPD, even outside of my relationship with food. I stopped seeing food as a cure to my problems - it's fuel, and that's all it should be. I realized that my mental disorder wasn't an excuse to not meet my goals or to interact with people in a different way...it's a setback for sure, and I'm not going to act like it doesn't affect me, but FPH taught me that like any other setback, it can be overcome.

Two years later and I'm travelling the world, studying my favorite subject (and doing really well!), I've learned 2 other languages besides English and though I haven't met all of my body goals (still working for some non-noodle arms and a perfectly flat tummy) I have the best diet I've ever had, I eat proper meals, I don't binge, I stay in the healthy weight range always and my weight hasn't fluctuated by more than 8lbs in over a year. And dammit I feel fantastic, even when I feel like shit it's never as low as I felt before, ever. And when I do feel like shit, I come over here to remind myself that I can get over that too, so long as I put in the work.

So thanks shitlords, you guys got me going, and keep me going <3
